headline: How to Get Dreaple
title: How to Get Dreaple in Aniimo | Evolve Nimbi at Night | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Dreaple comes from evolving Nimbi. First, raise Nimbi to level twenty one. Then learn the passive talent Dreamsong, and rest with your Pathfinder from night until day. After that, open the evolution panel and choose Dreaple. It becomes a Dark type support. Do not expect it to happen on its own, you have to pick it. Are you getting Dreaple? Comment below!
description: How to get Dreaple in Aniimo: raise Nimbi to level 21, learn Dreamsong and rest with the Pathfinder from night to day.
